name: @clossys/publisher
description: The publisher role: did we put it out to an audience, and can we prove what shipped? Surface composition, media registries, and channel renderers for web, email, print, images, and slides, plus a product-neutral structured-document contract, under `./core`, `./media`, `./web`, `./document`, `./email`, `./print`, `./image`, and `./slides`; an append-only, content-addressed record of what was published, to which channel, when, and citing which facts, plus a drift checker, under `./record`. One package, one version: every time the publisher runs, the record runs, and the record still does not import the composer.
author: Clossys

capabilities.subQuestion: What does this product owe its v0 Launch pack, and what already exists versus is still needed?
capabilities.worldClass: Every new product gets one declared inventory (clossys/publisher/pack.json, #1204) of what the v0 Launch pack owes it and what state each item is actually in — status, condition, version, source pins — never assembled ad hoc per product.

capabilities.subQuestion: Is every audience-facing surface declared once as a validated document, with its template and locations resolved?
capabilities.worldClass: Every published surface is one validated SurfaceDocument resolving to a registered template and a real channel location — never a page composed ad hoc outside the document.

capabilities.subQuestion: Does every declared surface render correctly to its channel — web, email, image, print, document, or slides?
capabilities.worldClass: A surface document renders byte-identically to its golden fixture on every channel it declares, checked, never eyeballed per release.

capabilities.subQuestion: Is every channel's template and spec declared once and reused, never improvised per page?
capabilities.worldClass: A channel template is data — a declared block sequence and spec — never an arbitrary per-page build function, per #1207's full set (overview, deck, email kit, social profile, video-call backgrounds). Today: only web page templates exist; the email kit, social/video-call templates, and the channel spec registry (#1207) do not.

capabilities.subQuestion: Is there one internal, locally opened materials index a client can browse every version of?
capabilities.worldClass: One assembled, current internal index (#1206) carries every version of the company overview (short/medium/long) and pitch deck (HTML slides with audience variants), each with a print stylesheet, opened locally or handed to a client — never a scatter of one-off files assembled by hand. Not a publicly deployed site: that is #1208's separate apps/site template.

capabilities.subQuestion: Is there one governed kit — assets, copy slots, specs — per channel a client can hand to that channel's own tool?
capabilities.worldClass: Every channel (email signatures, social profiles, video-call backgrounds, per #1207) has one governed kit of checked assets and copy slots at the exact sizes and roles that channel requires — never assembled by hand per send.

capabilities.subQuestion: Does every asset a document references resolve to a registered, checked entry at its required role and size?
capabilities.worldClass: Every image/video asset a document binds resolves to a registered roster entry (favicon, OG, Twitter, email-safe, app icons…) at its required pixel size with alt text — checked both directions, never a broken or orphaned reference.

capabilities.subQuestion: Does every publishing web route resolve to a registered template, with its visibility declared rather than inferred?
capabilities.worldClass: Every route composes only through a registered SurfaceDocument template — never Designer blocks assembled directly in a route file — and its visibility (public, unlisted, access-protected, per #1206) is declared, never inferred.

capabilities.subQuestion: Does a product repository get a working marketing site wired to its team's own records from the first commit?
capabilities.worldClass: An apps/site template (#1208) renders Publisher's web views and Designer's theme, reading copy, tokens, and assets from clossys/ at build time and never copying them — routes for landing, about, contact, privacy/terms, 404, metadata, sitemap, robots, all included.

capabilities.subQuestion: Once published, is the exact shipped result sealed into an immutable, append-only record, with every cited fact still current?
capabilities.worldClass: Every publication event is appended once to an immutable record — never overwritten, never silently lost — and every fact cited in what was sealed is re-checked against the current source value at seal time, with drift reported, never assumed absent. A surface seals only once Customer has recorded a keep.

capabilities.subQuestion: Does the production URL actually serve what was sealed — head, OG, metadata, and the materials index — independent of the hosting provider's own success signal?
capabilities.worldClass: `verify` (#1209) proves the live site and materials match the sealed publication record by independently re-reading the live URL — never trusting the deploy provider's own "success" status. Today: the reconciliation-loop contracts (an independent witness compared against a ledger) exist; nothing yet re-reads a live production URL.
